entry.subject: RUN-008 preregistration and measurement-contract freeze
entry.trigger: Proceed immediately from RUN-007 toward a full measured Calcifer energy-balance run without inventing the still-missing hardware parasitics.
result: R0P1A freezes channel names, units, sign conventions, energy integrals and closure rules before the unknown hardware measurements are observed.
RUN-008 v0.1 is preregistered with P0-P7 states and fixed verdict classes; it cannot issue a measured-net pass until physical metering is ingested.

A repository sweep found no hidden JANUS pump/AFPM/blower metrology record suitable for replacing the open watts; therefore the correct result is UNKNOWN_MEASUREMENT_INCOMPLETE rather than another modeled pass.
Old 12/10/8 W loads, 40% H-12 rating and published POMS flux remain comparison anchors only and are explicitly excluded from RUN-008 final measured claims.

The authoritative proof ledger remains E_A + E_B with external charging disconnected; regeneration remains creditable only against independently measured mechanical input or rotor kinetic-energy decrease.
entry.decision: The computational branch is now preregistered and waiting on physical R0P1A data. The next scientifically valid action is acquisition of P0-P7 measurements, not further numerical tuning.
